name: ai-context-buyer-platform
description: AI Context-Buyer Platform — мультиагентная SaaS для контекстной рекламы

scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @context-buyer/connectors && npm run build -w @context-buyer/agents && npm run start:dev -w api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @context-buyer/shared-types && npm run build -w @context-buyer/connectors && npm run build -w @context-buyer/agents && npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w api && npm run lint -w web
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build -w @context-buyer/connectors && npm run build -w @context-buyer/agents && npm run build -w api && playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.ts
scripts.qa:semantic: npm run build -w @context-buyer/connectors && npm run build -w @context-buyer/agents && npm run qa:semantic -w api --
